root_cause: Sudden spike in concurrent login requests exhausted available DB connections
resolution: Restarted service and increased database connection pool size

error: Timeout while calling third-party payment gateway
root_cause: External payment provider experienced high latency
resolution: Enabled retries and switched traffic to backup payment provider

error: Timeout while calling third-party payment gateway
root_cause: External payment provider experienced high latency
resolution: Enabled retries and switched traffic to backup payment provider

root_cause: Memory leak caused by unclosed user session objects
resolution: Restarted service, increased heap size, and deployed hotfix

root_cause: Consumer instances could not keep up with message ingestion rate
resolution: Scaled consumer instances and optimized message processing

root_cause: Service autoscaling was misconfigured
resolution: Fixed autoscaling policy and increased minimum replicas

root_cause: One of the data nodes ran out of disk space, preventing shard allocation
resolution: Cleared old indices and increased EBS volume size on the affected node

root_cause: Firewall rule change blocked port 587 from the application subnet
resolution: Reverted firewall rule and added automated security group audit

root_cause: Redis cache for session tokens became unavailable due to Out-Of-Memory (OOM)
resolution: Flushed Redis cache, increased memory limit, and changed eviction policy to volatile-lru

error: Invalid API Key error for FedEx integration
root_cause: Secrets manager rotated credentials but the service failed to reload them
resolution: Force-restarted service pods to pull latest environment variables

error: Bundle size exceeded warning; slow LCP
root_cause: New heavy library imported without tree-shaking
resolution: Removed unused imports and implemented route-based code splitting

root_cause: Backpressure from downstream S3 bucket due to rate limits
resolution: Increased S3 request concurrency and added local buffer disk

root_cause: Model feature store lookup became slow due to unindexed query
resolution: Added composite index to DynamoDB feature table

root_cause: Race condition in message processing; lack of idempotency key
resolution: Implemented idempotency keys at the database level and ran cleanup script

root_cause: Zookeeper leader election failure caused sync delay
resolution: Manually triggered leader re-election and increased tickTime

root_cause: Autovacuum was disabled on a high-write table
resolution: Ran manual VACUUM FREEZE and re-enabled autovacuum

root_cause: Public key rotation synchronization delay across cluster nodes
resolution: Flushed local key cache and forced reload from JWKS endpoint

root_cause: TLS 1.1 traffic was deprecated but legacy clients still attempted connection
resolution: Hardened TLS requirements to 1.2+ and notified legacy partners

root_cause: Heavy analytical query locking tables on the leader node
resolution: Killed long-running query and moved reporting tasks to a dedicated warehouse

root_cause: Liveness probe failure caused frequent pod restarts during peak traffic
resolution: Adjusted probe timeouts and increased CPU request limits

root_cause: API rate limit reached on the upstream provider (Cloudflare/Akamai)
resolution: Implemented request batching and exponential backoff for purges

root_cause: Docker image pruning was not cleaning up dangling volumes
resolution: Scheduled a daily cron job for 'docker system prune -af --volumes'

root_cause: S3 bucket policy was updated to remove 'GetObject' permissions
resolution: Restored IAM policy and added a Terraform drift detection alert

root_cause: Elasticsearch refresh interval was set too high to save on CPU
resolution: Reduced refresh_interval and optimized indexing bulk size

root_cause: Unchecked queue growth due to consumer service downtime
resolution: Purged dead-letter exchanges and scaled consumer pods

root_cause: Unusual traffic spike from a new marketing campaign
resolution: Increased provisioned concurrency limits and enabled Auto Scaling

root_cause: TTL was set too low, causing excessive load on the recursive resolver
resolution: Increased TTL to 3600 and updated nameserver records

root_cause: Cardinality explosion in custom metrics caused Prometheus OOM
resolution: Dropped high-cardinality labels and increased memory allocation

root_cause: Instance type reached its max EBS throughput limit
resolution: Upgraded instance family (e.g., from m5.large to m5.xlarge)

root_cause: Registry credentials expired on the Kubernetes secret
resolution: Refreshed service account token and patched the imagePullSecret

root_cause: Statistics for the main fact table were outdated
resolution: Ran 'ANALYZE' command and scheduled weekly stats updates

root_cause: Network congestion between the app subnet and the HSM appliance
resolution: Rerouted traffic through a dedicated private link

error: Incorrect location data for IP addresses
root_cause: Geo-location database was not updated during release
resolution: Manually triggered database sync and automated future updates

error: High bounce rate on transactional emails
root_cause: SPF/DKIM records missing for the new sending subdomain
resolution: Added TXT records for SPF/DKIM and verified via postmaster tools

error: Sticky session failure in Load Balancer
root_cause: Target group deregistration delay was too short
resolution: Increased deregistration delay to 300 seconds

root_cause: CORS policy blocked requests from the documentation domain
resolution: Added docs URL to the 'Allowed Origins' list in the API config

error: Multiple failed login attempts detected from a single IP
root_cause: Potential brute-force attack causing repeated authentication failures
resolution: Blocked IP address and enabled rate limiting on authentication endpoints

error: Expired TLS certificate caused HTTPS connection failures
root_cause: TLS certificate was not renewed before expiry date
resolution: Renewed TLS certificate and added certificate expiry monitoring

error: Intermittent packet loss between application and database services
root_cause: Faulty network switch causing unstable connectivity
resolution: Replaced faulty switch and rerouted traffic temporarily

error: Uneven traffic distribution causing backend overload
root_cause: Misconfigured load balancer health checks
resolution: Corrected load balancer configuration and validated health checks

error: Cache eviction due to memory limit reached
root_cause: Redis max memory limit too low for current workload
resolution: Increased memory allocation and optimized cache TTL values

error: Cache warm-up failure after restart caused latency spike
root_cause: Cache warm-up logic failed after service restart
resolution: Fixed warm-up logic and added fallback to database with rate limiting

error: Service crashed on startup after deployment
root_cause: Null pointer exception introduced in recent deployment
resolution: Rolled back to previous stable version and fixed the null reference bug

error: Database schema mismatch caused transaction failures
root_cause: Application code expected a new database column that was not deployed
resolution: Rolled back deployment and applied database migration in correct order

error: Single pod restarted due to temporary memory pressure
root_cause: Transient spike in memory usage during peak traffic
resolution: No action required as service recovered automatically

error: Metrics ingestion lag caused delayed alerts
root_cause: High ingestion load overwhelmed metrics processing pipeline
resolution: Scaled monitoring service horizontally and optimized ingestion batching
